name: Temperature & Humidity Sensor
description: Like an electronic weather forecaster! Measures air moisture and temperature digitally.
realWorldAnalogy: Like an electronic weather forecaster! Measures air moisture and temperature digitally.
wiringGuidance: Connect VCC (Red) to 5V, GND (Dark Slate) to GND, and DATA (Green) to digital pin 2 with a 10k pull-up resistor to 5V.
commonMistakes: Querying the sensor faster than once every 2 seconds, which leads to timeout errors.
Confusing 3-pin breakout modules with bare 4-pin components.

miniExperiment.title: Room Climate Check
miniExperiment.circuit: VCC to 5V, GND to GND, DATA to Pin 2.
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: Serial Monitor prints temperature and relative humidity every 2 seconds. Exhaling on the sensor spikes humidity to 90%+.
